result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both forms use visible labels and constrained controls: steppers for kayak counts and selects for time and duration. A has clearer section headings ('When', 'Kayaks', 'Your details') and better spacing between groups. B shows a running price total right after the trip details, before contact info, whereas no total or submit button is visible in A's screenshot. Neither screenshot shows the submit button or any required/optional markers, so I scored those items on what was visible. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both screenshots stop at about 800px, so neither submit button nor any required/optional marking can be seen, and those scores are low for both. Both use persistent labels, steppers for kayak counts, and selects for time and duration. A shows a running price total before the contact fields. B groups the form more clearly under When, Kayaks and Your details headings, but no price shows in its visible area, so the strengths cancel out.
